@custom/global/ImGui.documentation:
Synapse Z's ImGui library. Exposes a port of the Dear ImGui immediate-mode GUI API (windows, widgets, menus, popups, color pickers, and layout helpers) plus executor-specific extensions such as `OnRender`, `LoadImage`, `StringBuffer`, `GetFont` and `GetColorU32`.

Typical usage registers a render callback with `ImGui.OnRender`, then builds the UI inside it each frame.

```lua
ImGui.OnRender(function()
	ImGui.Begin("My Window")
	ImGui.Text("Hello, world!")
	ImGui.Button("Click me")
	ImGui.End()
end)
```

Flags are exposed as globals, e.g. `ImGuiWindowFlags_NoTitleBar`, `ImGuiChildFlags_Border`, `ImGuiCond_Appearing`, `ImGuiColorEditFlags_NoTooltip` and `ImGuiCol_Button`.

@custom/global/ImGui.ArrowButton.documentation: Draws a directional arrow button. Returns `true` when the button was clicked in this frame.

params.name: id
params.documentation: The unique ID of the button.

params.name: dir
params.documentation: Direction index (e.g. `0 = left`, `1 = right`, `2 = up`, `3 = down`).

@custom/global/ImGui.ArrowButtonEx.documentation: Draws an arrow button with an explicit size. Returns `true` when clicked.

params.name: id
params.documentation: The unique ID of the button.

params.name: size
params.documentation: The size of the button in pixels.

@custom/global/ImGui.Begin.documentation:
Begins a new window. Returns `true` while the window is open, and the current `open` state as a second value.

```lua
if ImGui.Begin("Window", open, ImGuiWindowFlags_NoResize) then
	-- draw widgets
end
ImGui.End()
```

params.name: name
params.documentation: The window title. Add `"###id"` to keep a stable ID while changing the displayed title.

params.name: open
params.documentation: Whether the window is currently open.

@custom/global/ImGui.BeginChild.documentation:
Begins a scrollable child region inside the current window. Returns `true` while the child is active.

```lua
if ImGui.BeginChild("Scroller", Vector2.new(200, 300), ImGuiChildFlags_Border) then
	-- draw items
end
ImGui.EndChild()
```

params.name: id
params.documentation: The unique ID of the child region.

params.name: size
params.documentation: The size of the child region.

@custom/global/ImGui.BeginCombo.documentation: Begins a combo box. Returns `true` while the combo popup is open.

params.name: label
params.documentation: The label / unique ID of the combo.

params.name: preview_value
params.documentation: The text shown on the closed combo box.

@custom/global/ImGui.BeginItemTooltip.documentation: Begins a tooltip attached to the item that was hovered, with an optional stable ID. Returns `true` while the tooltip is active.

params.name: id
params.documentation: Optional unique ID for the tooltip.

params.name: flags
params.documentation: Optional `ImGuiWindowFlags_*` flags for the tooltip window.

@custom/global/ImGui.BeginListBox.documentation: Begins a list box. Returns `true` while the list box is active. Call `ImGui.EndListBox()` when done.

params.name: label
params.documentation: The label / unique ID of the list box.

params.name: size
params.documentation: The size of the list box.

@custom/global/ImGui.BeginMenu.documentation: Begins a submenu inside a menu bar or another menu. Returns `true` while the submenu is open.

params.name: enabled
params.documentation: When `false`, the menu is greyed out and cannot be opened.

@custom/global/ImGui.BeginMenuBar.documentation: Begins the menu bar of the current window. Returns `true` while the menu bar is active.

@custom/global/ImGui.BeginPopup.documentation: Begins a popup previously opened with `ImGui.OpenPopup`. Returns `true` while the popup is open.

params.name: id
params.documentation: The ID the popup was opened with.

@custom/global/ImGui.BeginTooltip.documentation: Begins a tooltip window at the mouse position. Returns `true` while the tooltip is active.

@custom/global/ImGui.BeginTooltipEx.documentation: Begins a tooltip window with explicit flags.

@custom/global/ImGui.BeginTooltipHidden.documentation: Begins a tooltip window that is rendered without being visible, used to measure/query text without displaying it.

@custom/global/ImGui.Button.documentation:
Draws a button with the given label. Returns `true` when the button was clicked in this frame.

```lua
if ImGui.Button("Click me") then
	print("Clicked!")
end
```

params.name: label
params.documentation: The text shown on the button.

@custom/global/ImGui.ButtonEx.documentation: Draws a button with an explicit size and flags. Returns `true` when clicked.

params.name: label
params.documentation: The text shown on the button.

@custom/global/ImGui.CalcTextSize.documentation: Measures the rendered size of `text` and returns it as a `Vector2`.

params.name: size
params.documentation: The font pixel size used for measurement.

params.name: font_size
params.documentation: The font size (height) used for measurement.

@custom/global/ImGui.Checkbox.documentation:
Draws a checkbox. Returns whether the widget was drawn and the (possibly updated) checked state.

```lua
local shown, value = ImGui.Checkbox("Enable", enabled)
if shown then
	enabled = value
end
```

params.name: label
params.documentation: The label / unique ID of the checkbox.

@custom/global/ImGui.CollapsingHeader.documentation: Draws a collapsing header. Returns `true` while the header is open.

params.name: label
params.documentation: The label / unique ID of the header.

@custom/global/ImGui.ColorButton.documentation: Draws a button showing a color. Returns `true` when clicked.

params.name: label
params.documentation: The label / unique ID of the button.

params.name: size
params.documentation: Optional explicit size of the button.

@custom/global/ImGui.ColorPicker3.documentation:
Draws a full RGB color picker. Returns the current color after user edits.

```lua
local color = ImGui.ColorPicker3("Color", myColor, ImGuiColorEditFlags_NoLabel)
myColor = color
```

params.name: label
params.documentation: The label / unique ID of the picker.

@custom/global/ImGui.Combo.documentation: Draws a combo box from a list of strings. Returns whether the value changed and the newly selected index (1-based).

params.name: label
params.documentation: The label / unique ID of the combo.

params.name: current_item
params.documentation: The index of the currently selected item.

params.name: items
params.documentation: The list of items to choose from.

params.name: popup_max_height_in_items
params.documentation: Optional maximum number of visible items in the popup.

@custom/global/ImGui.EndChild.documentation: Ends a child region started with `ImGui.BeginChild`.

@custom/global/ImGui.EndCombo.documentation: Ends a combo box started with `ImGui.BeginCombo`.

@custom/global/ImGui.EndListBox.documentation: Ends a list box started with `ImGui.BeginListBox`.

@custom/global/ImGui.EndMenuBar.documentation: Ends a menu bar started with `ImGui.BeginMenuBar`.

@custom/global/ImGui.GetColorU32.documentation: Converts a `Color3` into an 32-bit RGBA integer suitable for low-level draw APIs, optionally multiplying alpha.

params.name: alpha_mul
params.documentation: Optional alpha multiplier applied to the color's alpha channel.

@custom/global/ImGui.GetCursorPos.documentation: Returns the cursor position relative to the current window's top-left corner.

@custom/global/ImGui.GetFont.documentation: Returns the currently active font object.

@custom/global/ImGui.GetWindowPos.documentation: Returns the position of the current window on screen.

@custom/global/ImGui.GetWindowSize.documentation: Returns the size of the current window.

@custom/global/ImGui.Image.documentation: Draws an image using a texture obtained from `ImGui.LoadImage`.

params.name: size
params.documentation: The rendered size of the image.

@custom/global/ImGui.ImageButton.documentation: Draws a button displaying an image. Returns `true` when clicked.

params.name: size
params.documentation: The rendered size of the button.

@custom/global/ImGui.Indent.documentation: Indents the current layout position by the given width (or the default indent width).

@custom/global/ImGui.InputText.documentation: Draws a single-line text input. Returns whether the value changed and the current text.

params.name: label
params.documentation: The label / unique ID of the input.

params.name: buf
params.documentation: The current text, or a `ImGui.StringBuffer` to persist edits.

@custom/global/ImGui.InputTextMultiline.documentation: Draws a multi-line text input. Returns whether the value changed and the current text.

params.name: label
params.documentation: The label / unique ID of the input.

params.name: buf
params.documentation: The current text, or a `ImGui.StringBuffer` to persist edits.

params.name: size
params.documentation: Optional size of the input area.

@custom/global/ImGui.InputTextWithHint.documentation: Draws a single-line text input with a hint shown while empty. Returns whether the value changed and the current text.

params.name: label
params.documentation: The label / unique ID of the input.

params.name: hint
params.documentation: The hint text shown when the input is empty.

params.name: buf
params.documentation: The current text, or a `ImGui.StringBuffer` to persist edits.

@custom/global/ImGui.InvisibleButton.documentation: Draws an invisible, clickable area. Returns whether the button was drawn and whether it was clicked.

params.name: label
params.documentation: The unique ID of the button.

params.name: size
params.documentation: The size of the clickable area.

@custom/global/ImGui.IsItemClicked.documentation: Returns whether the last item was clicked with the given mouse button.

params.name: mouse_button
params.documentation: The mouse button index (`0 = left`, `1 = right`, `2 = middle`).

@custom/global/ImGui.LoadImage.documentation: Loads an image from the given data (binary image data or a URL) and returns a texture usable with `ImGui.Image` and `ImGui.ImageButton`.

params.name: data
params.documentation: Image data or URL to load.

@custom/global/ImGui.MenuItem.documentation: Draws a menu item. Returns whether the item was drawn and whether it was clicked.

params.name: label
params.documentation: The label of the menu item.

params.name: shortcut
params.documentation: Optional shortcut text shown to the right (e.g. "Ctrl+S").

params.name: selected
params.documentation: Whether the item is shown as selected.

params.name: enabled
params.documentation: When `false`, the item is greyed out.

@custom/global/ImGui.OnRender.documentation:
Registers a callback that is invoked every render frame to build the ImGui UI. This is the entry point for drawing.

```lua
ImGui.OnRender(function()
	ImGui.Begin("My Window")
	ImGui.Text("Hello!")
	ImGui.End()
end)
```

params.name: callback
params.documentation: The function called each frame to render the UI.

@custom/global/ImGui.OpenPopup.documentation: Marks the popup with the given ID as open for the current frame.

params.name: id
params.documentation: The ID of the popup to open.

@custom/global/ImGui.PopId.documentation: Pops the last ID pushed with `ImGui.PushId`.

@custom/global/ImGui.PopItemWidth.documentation: Restores the item width that was active before the matching `ImGui.PushItemWidth`.

@custom/global/ImGui.PopStyleColor.documentation: Pops the last pushed style color, or `count` of them.

params.name: count
params.documentation: The number of style colors to pop.

@custom/global/ImGui.PushId.documentation: Pushes a string or number onto the ID stack, scoping the IDs of subsequently drawn widgets.

@custom/global/ImGui.PushItemWidth.documentation: Pushes a width (in pixels) applied to subsequent labeled widgets.

@custom/global/ImGui.PushStyleColor.documentation: Pushes a style color for the given `ImGuiCol_*` index, applied to subsequent widgets until `ImGui.PopStyleColor`.

@custom/global/ImGui.RadioButton.documentation: Draws a radio button. Returns whether the button was drawn and whether it is active.

params.name: label
params.documentation: The label / unique ID of the button.

params.name: active
params.documentation: Whether the radio button is currently selected.

@custom/global/ImGui.SameLine.documentation: Moves the cursor to the same line as the previous item, at the given horizontal offset.

params.name: offset
params.documentation: Optional horizontal offset from the start of the line.

@custom/global/ImGui.Selectable.documentation: Draws a selectable row. Returns whether it was drawn and whether it was clicked.

params.name: label
params.documentation: The label / unique ID of the selectable.

params.name: selected
params.documentation: Whether the selectable is currently selected.

@custom/global/ImGui.SetCursorPos.documentation: Sets the cursor position relative to the current window's top-left corner.

@custom/global/ImGui.SetItemAllowOverlap.documentation: Allows the next item to overlap with the previous item.

@custom/global/ImGui.SetItemDefaultFocus.documentation: Makes the next item the default focused item of its window/popup.

@custom/global/ImGui.SetKeyboardFocusHer.documentation: Gives keyboard focus to the next item, optionally skipping `offset` items first.

params.name: offset
params.documentation: How many items to skip before focusing.

@custom/global/ImGui.SetNextWindowPos.documentation: Sets the position of the next window created with `ImGui.Begin`.

params.name: pivot
params.documentation: Optional pivot point within the window.

@custom/global/ImGui.SetNextWindowSize.documentation: Sets the size of the next window created with `ImGui.Begin`.

@custom/global/ImGui.SetNextWindowSizeCo.documentation: Sets minimum/maximum size constraints for the next window, with an optional custom sizing callback.

params.name: custom_callback
params.documentation: Optional callback that adjusts the size.

params.name: custom_callback_data
params.documentation: Optional data passed to the callback.

@custom/global/ImGui.SetScrollHereX.documentation: Adjusts horizontal scrolling so the current item is centered (1.0 = rightmost).

params.name: center_x_ratio
params.documentation: Optional ratio of the item position to center on.

@custom/global/ImGui.SetScrollHereY.documentation: Adjusts vertical scrolling so the current item is centered (1.0 = bottom).

params.name: center_y_ratio
params.documentation: Optional ratio of the item position to center on.

@custom/global/ImGui.SliderAngle.documentation: Draws a slider for an angle in degrees. Returns whether the value changed and the current angle.

params.name: label
params.documentation: The label / unique ID of the slider.

params.name: format
params.documentation: Optional printf-style format string for the displayed value.

@custom/global/ImGui.SliderFloat.documentation: Draws a float slider. Returns whether the value changed and the current value.

params.name: label
params.documentation: The label / unique ID of the slider.

@custom/global/ImGui.SliderInt.documentation: Draws an integer slider. Returns whether the value changed and the current value.

params.name: label
params.documentation: The label / unique ID of the slider.

@custom/global/ImGui.SmallButton.documentation: Draws a small button. Returns `true` when clicked.

params.name: label
params.documentation: The text shown on the button.

@custom/global/ImGui.StringBuffer.documentation: Constructs a mutable string buffer used as the backing store for `ImGui.InputText*` widgets.

@custom/global/ImGui.TabItemButton.documentation: Draws a tab item button. Returns `true` when clicked.

params.name: label
params.documentation: The label / unique ID of the tab.

@custom/global/ImGui.Text.documentation: Draws text at the current cursor position.

@custom/global/ImGui.TextColored.documentation: Draws text using the given color.

@custom/global/ImGui.TextDisabled.documentation: Draws text in the disabled style color.

@custom/global/ImGui.TextEx.documentation: Draws text without applying label/`##` processing. Useful for raw text output.

@custom/global/ImGui.TextWrapped.documentation: Draws text with word wrapping enabled.

@custom/global/ImGui.TreePop.documentation: Pops the tree node stack, must be matched with a successful `ImGui.TreeNode` / `ImGui.TreeNodeEx`.

@custom/global/ImGui.TreeNode.documentation: Draws a collapsible tree node. Returns `true` while the node is open (call `ImGui.TreePop` afterwards).

params.name: label
params.documentation: The label / unique ID of the node.

@custom/global/ImGui.TreeNodeEx.documentation: Draws a collapsible tree node with explicit flags. Returns `true` while the node is open (call `ImGui.TreePop` afterwards).

params.name: label
params.documentation: The label / unique ID of the node.

@custom/global/ImGui.Unindent.documentation: Unindents the current layout position by the given width (or the default indent width).

@custom/globaltype/ImGuiStringBuffer.documentation: A mutable string buffer created with `ImGui.StringBuffer.new`, used to persist edits of `ImGui.InputText*` widgets.

@custom/globaltype/ImGuiStringBuffer.Tex.documentation: The current contents of the buffer.

@custom/globaltype/ImGuiStringBuffer.Set.documentation: Replaces the contents of the buffer.

@custom/globaltype/ImGuiStringBuffer.Get.documentation: Returns the current contents of the buffer.

@custom/global/ImGui.StringBuffer.new.documentation: Creates a new string buffer with the given initial text.

@custom/globaltype/ImGuiFont.GetScale.documentation: Returns the current scale of the font.

@custom/globaltype/ImGuiFont.SetScale.documentation: Sets the scale of the font.

@custom/globaltype/ImGuiFont.IsLoaded.documentation: Returns whether the font is loaded.

@custom/globaltype/ImGuiFont.IsDirty.documentation: Returns whether the font has pending changes that require a re-upload.

@custom/globaltype/ImGuiImage.documentation: An image texture loaded with `ImGui.LoadImage`, usable with `ImGui.Image` and `ImGui.ImageButton`.

@custom/globaltype/ImGuiImage.Width.documentation: The width of the image in pixels.

@custom/globaltype/ImGuiImage.Height.documentation: The height of the image in pixels.

@custom/globaltype/ImGuiImage.IsLoaded.documentation: Returns whether the image has finished loading.

@custom/global/crypt.documentation: Cryptography library exposing encryption, decryption, hashing, key generation, base64/hex encoding and compression utilities. Many functions are exposed under multiple aliases across different executors.

@custom/global/crypt.encrypt.documentation: Encrypts the given data using the specified key, optional IV and cipher mode. When no IV is provided, one is generated and returned alongside the ciphertext.

@custom/global/crypt.decrypt.documentation: Decrypts the given ciphertext using the specified key, IV and cipher mode.

@custom/global/crypt.userencrypt.documentation: Alias of `crypt.encrypt` for the user cipher.

@custom/global/crypt.user_encrypt.documentation: Alias of `crypt.encrypt` for the user cipher.

@custom/global/crypt.userdecrypt.documentation: Alias of `crypt.decrypt` for the user cipher.

@custom/global/crypt.user_decrypt.documentation: Alias of `crypt.decrypt` for the user cipher.

@custom/global/crypt.user.documentation: Sub-library exposing the user cipher functions.

@custom/global/crypt.user.encrypt.documentation: Encrypts the given data using the user cipher, specified key, optional IV and cipher mode. When no IV is provided, one is generated and returned alongside the ciphertext.

params.name: iv
params.documentation: Optional initialization vector. When omitted, a random IV is generated and returned as the second value.

@custom/global/crypt.user.decrypt.documentation: Decrypts the given ciphertext using the user cipher, specified key, IV and cipher mode.

@custom/global/crypt.sealencrypt.documentation: Encrypts the given data using the SEAL cipher and the given key.

@custom/global/crypt.sealdecrypt.documentation: Decrypts SEAL-encrypted data using the given key.

@custom/global/crypt.sealkeygen.documentation: Generates a SEAL encryption/decryption key pair. Returns the public and private keys.

@custom/global/crypt.sign.documentation: Signs the given data using the given signing key.

@custom/global/crypt.signopen.documentation: Verifies the signature on the given signed data using the given key and returns the original data.

@custom/global/crypt.signkeygen.documentation: Generates a signing key pair. Returns the public and secret keys.

@custom/global/crypt.lz4.documentation: Compresses the given data using LZ4.

@custom/global/crypt.hex.documentation: Encodes the given data as a hexadecimal string.

@custom/global/crypt.hexdecode.documentation: Decodes a hexadecimal string back to binary data.

@custom/global/crypt.base64.documentation: Encodes the given data as base64.

@custom/global/crypt.base64decode.documentation: Decodes base64 data back to a string.

@custom/global/crypt.generatebytes.documentation: Generates the given number of random bytes and returns them as a string.

params.name: size
params.documentation: The number of random bytes to generate.

params.name: size
params.documentation: The number of random bytes to generate.

@custom/global/crypt.random.documentation: Generates the given number of cryptographically secure random bytes and returns them as a string.

params.name: size
params.documentation: The number of random bytes to generate.

@custom/global/crypt.derivekey.documentation: Derives a cryptographic key from a password using the given salt, iteration count and key length.

params.name: password
params.documentation: The password to derive a key from.

params.name: keyLength
params.documentation: The desired key length in bytes.

params.name: password
params.documentation: The password to derive a key from.

params.name: keyLength
params.documentation: The desired key length in bytes.

@custom/global/crypt.derivepassword.documentation: Derives a cryptographic hash from a password and salt.

params.name: password
params.documentation: The password to derive a hash from.

params.name: password
params.documentation: The password to derive a hash from.

@custom/global/crypt.hash.documentation: Hashes the given data using the specified algorithm.

@custom/global/http.documentation: Library for making HTTP requests and retrieving host information.

params.name: object
params.documentation: The object whose metatable contains the metamethod.

params.name: metamethod_name
params.documentation: The name of the metamethod to hook, e.g. `__index` or `__namecall`.

@custom/global/ismetamethodhooked.documentation: Returns whether the given metamethod on the object has been hooked.

params.name: object
params.documentation: The object whose metatable to inspect.

params.name: metamethod_name
params.documentation: The name of the metamethod to check, e.g. `__index` or `__namecall`.

params.name: functionToRestore
params.documentation: The function to restore to its original implementation.

params.name: functionToRestore
params.documentation: The function to restore to its original implementation.

@custom/global/cansignalreplicate.documentation: Returns whether the given signal can be replicated to the server.

@custom/global/setconnectionenabled.documentation: Enables or disables the given connection obtained from `getconnections`.

params.name: enabled
params.documentation: Whether the connection should be enabled.
